newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy petroleum products use falls in March - UP.
newsitem.headline: Italy petroleum products use falls in March - UP.

text.p: Italy's consumption of petroleum products fell by 9.7 percent in March to 7.5 million tonnes from levels seen a year earlier, a statement from Italian industry body Unione Petrolifera said.

A particular sharp fall was seen in the demand for fuel oil for use at electricity power generators, down by 18 percent. Also in decline was the consumption of gas oil, down by 14.3 percent, while the consumption of petrol was stable in March.
UP noted that there was one less working day in March 1997 compared to March 1996.
